title: campioni/1: metadata of the samples of a series
description: One entry per file of the series, in the order of injection. Proposed from the file names by mzlab-feat (samples.rs, the rules of mzlab-core::project) and edited by the user. The SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (fixed order of the keys) is recorded by the `campioni` operation of the .mzflow. Changing a metadatum does not change the detection: only the views and the identities are recomputed.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw file (the one of its .mzidx)

istd.description: the file is an internal standard
